h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Yamunanagar

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Yamunanagar

c: Yamunanagar, with its twin town Jagadhri, is one of north India's main centres for plywood and timber, close to the Shivalik foothills. Factories, mills and their staff colonies are a large part of the town. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Yamunanagar for these industrial campuses, and for schools, colleges, municipal parks and residential colonies. Our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, is about 1,280 km away.

Summers are hot, the monsoon is fairly heavy near the hills, and winters bring cold, misty mornings. Our Fun Fitness machines are galvanised pipe with roto-moulded parts, so they stay outdoors through all three seasons. We send the order to Haryana by road, and our team or a dealer in north India installs it once you approve a layout drawing.

facts.label: Delivery and installation

items.q: Can a plywood factory set up an outdoor gym for workers?
items.a: Yes. A few combination machines near the staff quarters or canteen work well. Share the space and number of workers, and we will send a layout and quote.

items.q: How do we stop wood dust getting into the machines?
items.a: Place the gym on a paved base away from the sawing areas, sweep it often and wipe the moving parts weekly. Our after-sales team can advise on a care routine.
Yes. We deliver by road from our Vasai factory to any part of India and install through our own team or a dealer in north India.
